metadata.description: RQ2-D1 screen panel subset: one row per (concept, analysis year t) with W1 baselines, openness at t (closure_res etc., z-scored on the full panel) and W2=[t+1,t+5] breadth outcomes (Y1r, Y2, Y3).
metadata.source: results/d1/panel_ct.parquet (+ work/indicators_open.parquet for the R1a fit rows) of the RQ2-D1 experiment
metadata.selection: whole concepts, stratified by population (MAIN vs SENSITIVITY-only) and origin group; seed 7

rowcount_decision.F3_rule: if complete-case closure_res leaves < 150 screen MAIN concepts or < 500 rows -> closure_res_imp co-primary
rowcount_decision.coprimary_rule: D1_SUPPORTED_SCREEN requires the pre-declared rule to hold for closure_res AND for closure_res_imp on the same outcome (conservative conjunction; no forking)
rowcount_decision.F4_rule: if n* < 20 in > 40% of MAIN rows -> Y1r floor 10 and Y1r20 -> Y1r10

panel.phrase: measurement device independent quantum key distribution
